svg.text: FUSION / Spatial alternative B — raised A, sunken B, assembly crown
Independent provisional organization · serious macro alternative · 5v5 / two objectives · metres / Z up / Y north ↑
B basin + partial internal vessel service route
Equatorial route remains the ordinary transfer level
Partial external crescent; long, exposed acquisition cost
D vessel 19.4m diameter / 11.4m high; section is one radial half.
Colored strips show reserved deck bands, not verified clearances.
Lower deck beneath 0 slab: nominal 2.9m headroom before fixtures.
• A at +3.2; B at −3.2. Their entrance positions remain distinct.
• Lower vessel arc R4.6–6.8 / 210°–350°; nominal 2.9m below deck 0.
• Lower bridges use unfinished coil sectors; collars and shielding
apertures require section tests through every machine layer.
• Crown R18.6–21.4 at +6.4 is outside the bioshield, not a vessel roof.
• Crown-to-B requires descent through +3.2 and 0; it is not instant.
• Enlarge the occupied hall/wing roofs: +7.2 roofs cannot cover +6.4 play.
• B retains a lower sheltered room beneath part of the ground shelf.
• Stair footprints are reservations; settle landings/screens in development.
• No required jump, ladder, drop or lift. Every route uses ordinary stairs.
